speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: Singapore is striving to be a Smart Nation, where citizens live meaningful and fulfilled lives empowered by technology; where digital connectivity leads to stronger community bonds; and where there will be many opportunities for Singaporeans to pursue their aspirations and contribute to Singapore's future.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: Various Ministries have mentioned in their respective Addendum how they intend to leverage technology to improve services and capabilities for citizens.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: The Office will collaborate with citizens, industry and Government agencies, so that, collectively, we leverage technology in a concerted and integrated manner to address our national challenges, improve quality of life and benefit the society and economy.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: We will focus on areas in which technology can create the greatest positive impact on our daily lives.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: The pilots involve residents providing feedback to ensure that the solutions are human-centric and designed to meet their real-life needs.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: We want to position Singapore well, as part of the global value chain that will seize opportunities arising from the global digital revolution.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: Singapore can be the living laboratory for companies to prototype and co-develop proof-of-concepts with our own researchers and innovators.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: The innovative solutions that work can be piloted, scaled up quickly in Singapore and adapted beyond our shores as global solutions.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: Such opportunities, to test out new approaches and to give good ideas the runway to take flight, will also contribute to an attractive environment for startups and entrepreneurs.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: Indeed, entrepreneurship is a key ingredient of the Smart Nation we are building.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: We will continue to foster an attractive environment for entrepreneurial talent and strengthen our startup ecosystem to create exciting avenues for our young entrepreneurs to thrive and succeed.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: For various industries, Smart Nation also presents opportunities to leverage on technology to improve processes and productivity and generate new revenue streams.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: We have taken the first steps to do so, to allow citizens to co-create solutions to address the needs of the community.
